project_type: Vanilla JS cinematic experience platform with canvas-based particle universe
build_system: Vite (dev server and bundler). npm registry is BLOCKED - no npm install possible.
test_framework: None - no test infrastructure exists. Validation is structural/AST only.
verification_instructions: 1. Run syntax checks on all new files. 2. Verify imports resolve. 3. Confirm no circular dependencies.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - all code is vanilla JS with ES module imports. npm registry blocked.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - npm registry blocked. Cannot install packages. Must use only vanilla JS and existing dependencies already declared in package.json (gsap, lenis, three, lottie-web, motion, lucide). Prefix all node commands with NODE_OPTIONS='' to avoid preload errors.
contribution_requirements: No function > 60 lines, no class > 400 lines. No magic numbers. Zero allocations in render/update loops. Document public APIs. Everything modular, configurable, deterministic.
key_patterns: Scenes follow lifecycle: getId(), setUniverse(), load(), enter(), update(dt), leave(), destroy(). Subsystems init/update/destroy pattern with MANAGER_STATES. SceneDirector manages emotional phases with onEnter/onUpdate/onLeave callbacks. ParticleEngine pool is flat array of {x,y,vx,vy,ax,ay,opacity,targetOpacity,scale,active,...}. ConnectionPrediction.getCandidateConnections() returns [{indexA, indexB, distSq}]. CameraController.setTarget(x,y) for attention. AudioArchitecture.registerEvent/emit for hooks. BehaviorSystem uses register/enable/disable pattern. BackgroundRenderer has layer system with setLayerRenderer. Constants in js/config/constants.js, settings in js/config/settings.js (both frozen).
directory_structure: js/engine/ - core engine, managers, universe/ subsystems. js/scenes/ - scene classes with scene00N/ subdirs for phases. js/config/ - constants.js and settings.js. js/utils/ - helpers, math, Noise. css/ - modular CSS files imported by main.css.
